description: This Java class `DefaultMetricsConfig` implements the `MetricsConfig` interface, providing configuration management for metrics-related settings in the Ditto service. It reads configuration values such as whether system metrics and Prometheus are enabled, and the hostname and port for Prometheus, from a config object, and provides accessor methods. It also overrides `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` for object comparison, hashing, and debugging.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetricsConfig, encapsulating metrics configuration parameters such as enabled flags, hostname, and port.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMetricsConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: isSystemMetricsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether system metrics are enabled.

methods.name: isPrometheusEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether Prometheus metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: getPrometheusHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for Prometheus server.

methods.name: getPrometheusPort
methods.description: Returns the port for Prometheus server.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration objects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for proper hashing based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration.
